_about: Provisional map of GP4.exe .text from function alignment/padding fingerprints, string evidence and calling-style statistics (gp4re analyze, 2026-10-02). The lead refines boundaries with `gp4re work region ...`. 'exclude': true removes unconfirmed functions in the region from the worker queue.

regions.label: R1-asm-core
regions.note: Unaligned, unpadded, ~60% of functions take register/flag/x87-stack inputs; essentially no strings or imports. Hand-written x87 assembly: Crammond's simulation core (physics/AI/maths). Semantic (emulator) track. Boundary moved 2026-10-20 from 0x440000 to 0x446160: the 231 functions in 0x440000..0x446160 are unaligned and unpadded like R1 (none 16-aligned in 0x440000..0x442000), reference no strings or imports, and take register inputs; aligned nop-padded C++ (thiscall) starts at 0x446160.

regions.label: R2-cpp-renderer
regions.note: 16-byte aligned, nop padded C++ (thiscall-heavy): CGP4*Shader, CSkyDome, CGP4Cockpit, HUD text ids, memory manager. GP4's D3D8 renderer/front-end layer.

regions.label: R3-c-legacy
regions.note: Unaligned C with an asm mix: gamestate save/load (f1gstate.dat), gconfig.txt, circuits\*.dat, .jam textures, 'D:\grand prix 3', GP3 2000 network/2-player sessions. GP3-heritage game logic.

regions.label: R4-libs
regions.note: D3DX mesh code (ID3DXMeshOptimize, D3DXValidMesh), DirectX-file loader (d3dxof), CPU-specific SIMD pipeline (DisableD3DXPSGP, GenuineIntel/AuthenticAMD), libpng (1.0.5 version string), zlib. Confirm against the DirectX 8.1 SDK d3dx8.lib / libpng / zlib before treating as final.

regions.label: R5-cpp-mixed
regions.note: 16-byte aligned C++ like R2, plus DirectX error-string tables (D3DERR_*, DMUS_S_* - dxerr8.lib) and zlib inflate strings. Needs function-level library identification; queued at low priority. Boundary moved 2026-10-22 from 0x5d8000 to 0x5da800: the R6 triage found 0x5d8030-0x5da7ff is game C++ continuing R5 (thiscall methods, calls into 0x5b..-0x5d.., GP4 globals 0xb2xxxx-0xb4xxxx, the Bink video player with binkw32 imports and 'BINK ERROR' strings, the Objects\EnvFace%s.tga loader); libcmt starts at _fpmath 0x5da8e0. The R5 triage found no library code in 0x5be000-0x5d8000 and only dinput8 data formats (c_dfDIMouse 0x5a4560, c_dfDIJoystick 0x5a45e0) in 0x5a4000-0x5be000.

regions.label: R6-crt
regions.note: Visual C++ 6 runtime tail (entry point 0x5ddec6, 'Runtime Error', heap selection, locale) with a few D3DX/game functions interleaved. Evidence-labelled CRT functions are excluded individually. 2026-10-22 triage: 486 CRT routines and 295 compiler EH funclets/handlers identified function by function (each checked by a refuter) and excluded; the region holds no game code after 0x5da800.
